page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head and page number at the top; catchword "Per" at the bottom right; signature "F 2" at the foot.

main_text.head: XVIII. RESPONSUM.
main_text.p: Serenissimi Regis Navarreni, &c. Legato, Generoso ac magnifico viro, Domino Jacobo Pardeliano, Domus Regiæ Præfecto, &c. ab Illustrissimo Principe ac Domino, Domino Johanne Georgio, Marchione Brandeburgensi, Sacri Romani Imperii Archicamerario & Electore, in Borusia, Stetini, Pomeraniæ, Cassubiorum & Vandalorum, necnon in Silesia Crosni Duce, Burgravio Norenburgensi & Principe Rugiæ, ad Negotia proposita datum.

page.notes: The page is a printed page of the 1600s; the heading and text are set in roman with black-letter-like heavy type in places. Some words in the scan are damaged and partly illegible, notably in the lines "Georgio", "Brandeburgensi" and "proposita"; the readings given are the most likely ones. Ink spots and stray marks in the margins were omitted.
